decisions.subject: 0x0016 versus 0x001A
decisions.decision: Keep separate entries: actual Congo battle and preceding approach. The broad Oedo Castle labels are compatible; no contradictory final name remains.

decisions.subject: Area groups versus specific locations
decisions.decision: Prefer the exact location catalog or native room check. Preserve generic labels with an explicit unknown-chamber qualifier when no narrower name is established.

decisions.subject: 0x0049 and 0x0071
decisions.decision: Refine Ghost Toys Castle to Dharumanyo battle and Festival Temple Castle to Tsurami battle. Do not confuse similarly named ordinary actor IDs with room IDs.

decisions.subject: 0x0171
decisions.decision: Benkei combat and noncombat presence share Benkei Bridge. Room ID does not itself distinguish whether the fight is active.

decisions.subject: 0x0260
decisions.decision: Exclude from current-room list: only system destination-stage value for Impact boss rush is established.

evidence.note: Native launch writes 0x260 to system destination_stage and enters step 0x0C.

decisions.subject: Coordinates in location catalog
decisions.decision: Do not publish as D_8006B780 native values. The location catalog provides chosen coordinates while native table reads supply rotations; these are different sources of data.

decisions.subject: Save-spawn Y/Z macro names
decisions.decision: Use the agreed entry struct order X,Y,Z,camera,player for D_8006B780. Differently named save-field macros in one caller do not redefine this table layout.

decisions.subject: Conflicting spellings
decisions.decision: Normalize Mt./punctuation and possessive coffee-shop variants only. Retain geographical distinctions and source candidates in per-room records.

decisions.subject: Unrelated number domains
decisions.decision: Exclude save flag IDs, actor/entity IDs, allocation categories, session room strings and mode destination values without a confirmed current-room mapping.

decisions.subject: 0x01B8 broad area versus interior label
decisions.decision: Publish the specific interior label Oedo Tourist Center - Awa branch rather than asserting the broad Folkypoke Village grouping is an exact room name. Both original candidates are retained for audit.

auditedCheckouts.findings: Broad Python room-name mapping, specific C room/location catalog, boss room constants, Goemon-house confirmation, room table declaration/layout/index expressions. Inspected source/include/docs and native config; no additional named current-room mapping was found outside those sources.
Exact Dharumanyo, Tsurami, Benkei, Koryuta flight constants; explicit Congo actual-fight/preceding-room distinction. Tests used as supporting source context only.
Save/fish quest flags and counters, but no named native room ID mapping.
Current-room transition checks with no named native room constants in source/docs.
Native Impact boss-rush destination 0x260 documented; not promoted to a current-room value.

limitations: No new in-game room traversal was performed. Labels are supported by the audited source mappings and room checks.
Most dungeon chamber IDs have only area-level labels. Repeated names do not mean the IDs are interchangeable.
Unlisted room IDs remain undocumented, not necessarily invalid.
Native table values were not dumped; only the five-short layout and arithmetic are published.
The active Ghidra database returned no xrefs at 0x8006B780 in this pass; no database changes were made.
